risk_note: RV2 (settlement rights / rebate / restore, orders update-step source, ledger invariant ⑧). FU-P7-ORDER-RIGHTS-ROW (orchestrator D10-1118 / D10-1124 / D10-1125 / D10-1126 ②③ / D10-1133 / D10-1134 / D10-1140 / D10-1147 / D10-1149; 08 second-batch write-back couli b7ff780 in SPEC_REF). The order sync now writes, in settlement on the sync transaction (settlement/rights/sync-rights.ts, called at the start of the rebate port's onUpdated, before R6 / R8): P7 (PLATFORM_INVALID from SETTLED, platform_status unchanged) → order_rights {INVALID_AFTER_SETTLE, SUCCEEDED, platform_rights_no 'P' || the row_version the sync update wrote, passed by orders as OrderStatusSource.sync_row_version (optional; only on PLATFORM_INVALID because update-step.test.ts U9 / U10 compare the third argument exactly)}, on CREDITED, unbooked and already CLAWED_BACK / VOID orders alike; P8 punishment (PLATFORM_PUNISH on PAID / RECEIVED / SETTLED) → {PUNISH, SUCCEEDED, no number}. Idempotency is the K-2 unique index (insertRights ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); a restore followed by a new invalid report writes a new row. No amount, deduction or second clawback: R6 / R8 money paths, the P{row_version} clawback key and reasons are unchanged; rights_pending recomputed on the same transaction. BR-FUND-19 ⑧: db/invariants/ledger/10_invalid-still-credited-since-restore.sql supersedes 08 (superseded.json appended one entry; old 08 untouched, append-only like B2-02l): a successful INVALID_AFTER_SETTLE counts only when its updated_at is not before the order's last R12 / R13 (order_status_history field rebate, event ADMIN_RESTORE, from VOID / CLAWED_BACK); the platform_status = INVALID branch and the global no_beneficiary_account row are unchanged. BR-FUND-22 re-check: platform-restore.ts refuses R12 / R13 with restore_platform_invalid when a successful INVALID_AFTER_SETTLE has updated_at >= the difference's recon_diffs.created_at (ReconDiffRestoreRow gains created_at). Two frozen kits had the old 08 file name replaced by the new one only (test/spec/ledger/daily-check-execute/kit.ts:66, test/spec/settlement/admin-union-receipts/kit.ts:97; D10-327 / D10-1140, confirmed one line each by spec-test r2). Host checks on the implementation commit: root tsc -b 0, eslint 0, unit 40 files 276 tests, integration 10 groups 112 files 645 tests (sync-order-rights, daily-check-execute, admin-union-receipts, platform-restore, admin-recon-restore, clawback, rights, db/ledger, commission/version-rule, commission/estimate-port). Full verification by the required CI checks.
